name: Arm circles and shoulder rolls
description: Gentle arm circles and shoulder rolls to warm up the upper body.

name: Band row hold
description: Light band rows with a pause at the end, staying tall through the torso.

name: Wall push-up
description: Push-ups against a wall at a slow, controlled pace.

name: Push-up to row
description: Alternate a push-up with a single-arm row from the plank position.

name: Seated dumbbell press
description: Press both dumbbells overhead from a seated position with a braced back.

name: Plank row
description: From a plank, row each dumbbell while keeping the hips level.

name: Kettlebell halo
description: Circle the kettlebell around the head while keeping the ribs down.

name: Single-arm dumbbell press
description: Press one dumbbell at a time to build control through the trunk.

name: Weighted pull-up
description: Pull-ups with added load, lowered slowly on each rep.
caution: Lower slowly and keep the shoulders packed. Stop if you feel elbow pain.

name: Heavy push press
description: Drive a heavy bar overhead using the legs, then lock out the arms.
caution: Use a squat rack and safety bars. Keep the bar close and the trunk braced.

name: Clean and press
description: Complex lift from the floor to overhead, with a press at the top.
caution: Complex lift with real injury risk. Learn the movement with light weight first.
